CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Steven W. Huang, DDS, Mayor  www.cityofsanmarino.org
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone
Susan Jakubowski, Council Member  (626) 300-0709 Fax
Steve Talt, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber
Ken Ude, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Marcella Marlowe, Ph.D., City Manager  San Marino, CA 91108

  REGULAR MEETING
  WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 13, 2019
  6:00 P.M.
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the
Council with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular Meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
Adjourned Meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:00 a.m.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should
contact the City Clerk’s Office at (626) 300-0705 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL:  Council Member Jakubowski, Council Member Talt, Council
  Member Ude, Vice Mayor Shepherd Romey, and Mayor Huang

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City
Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and
the Recreation Department, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the
City’s Website: http://www.cityofsanmarino.org
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – FEBRUARY 13, 2019  PAGE 2 OF 5

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City Council welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City
Council by completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the
meeting. At this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on
the agenda. Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on
issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor
reserves the right to place limits on the duration of comments. Staff may be asked to
follow up on such items.

CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the City Manager to inform the City Council and the public of
any upcoming events or matters of interest to the Community.

MOTION TO WAIVE FURTHER READINGS

This action permits the City Council to act on ordinances and resolutions without having
to read the entire text of the ordinance or resolution. The title of an ordinance on First
Reading must be read in its entirety. An ordinance on Second Reading does not require
having the title read. However, the City Council may request that an ordinance or
resolution be read in its entirety before taking any action.

  CEREMONIAL

1.  CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY BOOKMARK DESIGN CONTEST
  WINNERS 2019

  CONSENT CALENDAR

Members of the public may at this time speak on any items on the Consent Calendar.
After which, the Mayor will request members of the City Council to indicate if there are
any items on the Consent Calendar that should be discussed individually. These items
will be pulled from the Consent Calendar and acted on separately.

2.  RECEIVE AND FILE DISBURSEMENTS REPORT FOR JANUARY 2019

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council receive and file the
  Disbursements Report for the month of January 2019.

3.  RECEIVE AND FILE FINANCIAL REPORT AS OF DECEMBER 31, 2018

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council receive and file the report.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – FEBRUARY 13, 2019  PAGE 3 OF 5

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve the minutes of the
  regular meeting of January 4, 2019, the special meeting of January 9, 2019, the
  regular meeting of January 9, 2019, and the adjourned regular meeting of January
  25, 2019.

5.  RECEIVE AND FILE – EMERGENCY TREE REMOVAL REPORT –
  2250 ROANOKE ROAD

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council receive and file the report.

6.  RECEIVE AND FILE – EMERGENCY TREE REMOVAL REPORT –
  2916 SOMERSET PLACE

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council receive and file the report.

7.  2019 STREET POLE BANNER PROPOSAL FROM THE SAN MARINO
  SCHOOLS FOUNDATION

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve a request from
  the San Marino Schools Foundation that is in accordance with Resolution No. R-
  14-22 for the installation and display of banners citywide between April 1 and
  June 28, 2019.

  CITY TREASURER’S REPORT

8.  CASH AND INVESTMENT  REPORT  FOR  THE  MONTH  OF
  DECEMBER 2018

  Recommendation: Receive and file the Cash and Investment Report for the
  month of December 2018.

  NEW BUSINESS

9.  ACCEPTANCE OF $17,665 DONATION FROM SAN MARINO
  RESIDENT WINNIE REITNOUER AND APPROVAL TO PURCHASE
  ONE (1) ZOLL AUTOPULSE RESUSCITATION SYSTEM

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council: 1) accept the
  designated donation of $17,665 from Winnie Reitnouer and approve the purchase
  of one Zoll AutoPulse Resuscitation System; 2) approve the FY 19 revenue
  budget to be amended to recognize revenue of $17,665 in the Donations Fund
  (Account # 281-34-3601-0000); and 3) approve a FY 19 expenditure budget
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – FEBRUARY 13, 2019  PAGE 4 OF 5

  amendment by appropriation of $17,665 to the Donations Fund for the Zoll
  AutoPulse Resuscitation System as applied to Non-Capitalized Equipment-Fire
  (Account # 281-34-4399-0000).

10.  PRESENTATION OF THE FY 19 MID-YEAR REPORT AND FUTURE
  PROJECTIONS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council receive the report.

11.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION R-19-02, APPROVING THE FINAL
  DRAFT OF THE CITY OF SAN MARINO LOCAL HAZARD
  MITIGATION PLAN

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the San
  Marino Local Hazard Mitigation Plan.

12.  ORDINANCE PROHIBITING SHARED MOBILITY DEVICES IN THE
  PUBLIC RIGHT-OF-WAY OR ON PUBLIC PROPERTY, OR OFFERING
  THEM FOR USE ANYWHERE IN THE CITY (1ST READING)

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council introduce for first
  reading by title only, Ordinance No. O-19-1348, an Ordinance of the City of San
  Marino adding Article 09 (Shared Mobility Devices) to Chapter 16 (Streets and
  Sidewalks) of the San Marino City Code to prohibit shared mobility devices from
  being placed in any public right-of-way or on public property, operated in any
  public right-of way or on public property, or offered for use anywhere in the City.

13.  APPROVAL OF CITY ORDINANCE PROHIBITING URINATING OR
  DEFECATING IN PUBLIC, FIRST READING

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council introduce for first
  reading by title only, Ordinance No. O-19-1349, an Ordinance of the City Council
  of the City of San Marino, prohibiting public urination and defecation; and
  amending the San Marino City Code regarding the same.

14.  DISCUSSION REGARDING THE PROPOSED PEAFOWL ABATEMENT
  PROGRAM

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council select Option 1 – the
  creation of a Peafowl Abatement Plan Guide.

15.  APPROVAL OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE CITY MANAGER’S
  EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

  Recommendation: The City Attorney recommends the City Council approve the
  amendment to the City Manager’s contract.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – FEBRUARY 13, 2019  PAGE 5 OF 5

16.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NOS. R-19-03 AND R-19-04, APPROVING
  THE APPOINTMENT OF TWO RETIRED ANNUITANTS TO THE
  POSITIONS OF INTERIM FINANCE DIRECTOR AND INTERIM
  HUMAN RESOURCES MANAGER, RESPECTIVELY

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve Resolution Nos.
  R-19-03 and R-19-04.

  PUBLIC HEARING

17.  APPROVAL FOR MODIFICATION TO CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT
  CUP94-22 AND VARIANCE V96-15, 2265 HUNTINGTON DRIVE (KT
  ENTERPRISES/STARBUCKS)

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council affirm the Planning
  Commission’s approval of the modification to CUP94-22.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of
San Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda
will be made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington
Drive, San Marino, California 91108.

COUNCIL REPORTS

This is an opportunity for members of the City Council to inform the public of any
meetings or conferences they may have attended.

CITY COUNCIL CALENDAR

Scheduling dates for future Council meetings.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

The San Marino City Council will adjourn to FRIDAY, FEBRUARY 22, 2019, at 8:00
A.M. in Barth Room at the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino,
California 91108.

Dated: February 8, 2019  AMANDA FOWLER
Posted: February 8, 2019  ACTING CITY CLERK
